function.name: bookStrategyCall
function.description: Books a strategy call on the IntakeOps Google Calendar at a time returned by checkCalendar. Only call this after the caller has picked one of the offered times.

start_time.description: The exact start_time value from checkCalendar for the option the caller picked, e.g. 2026-10-05T11:00:00.000-04:00.

notes.description: One sentence: business type, weekly call volume, and what they want to cover.
